text: Debugging is an important skill for any programmer. When your code does not work, the first step is identifying bugs. You need to find where the problem is and understand why it happens. Many developers use debugging tools, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution, to watch how the program runs. However, a systematic approach is even more important. Instead of changing code randomly, you should test one idea at a time. Another useful method is logging. By adding log messages, you can see what the program is doing and find errors more easily. With patience and good strategies, you can solve most problems.
